title: Wrapper div may conflict with MudTabs internal key handling
note: MudBlazor 8.x MudTabs does not bind ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End on its internal tab buttons — confirmed via prior UAT finding that drove this session's work. Double-nav risk Opus raised is not observed in practice; no code change. Surfacing here so future MudBlazor upgrades that add built-in arrow support are caught.

title: @onkeydown:preventDefault off-by-one would break Tab navigation after an arrow press
note: Removed @onkeydown:preventDefault and the _preventDefaultTabKey field entirely. Arrow keys and Home/End on a non-scrollable wrapper div do not trigger a browser default, and this wrapper is not focusable directly. The handler still fires via bubbling from MudTabs buttons.

title: Save() is internal void, not async Task
note: Current MudDialog.Close path is synchronous; void is correct for the existing Blazor event pipeline. Worth revisiting only if the Close path becomes async.

title: bUnit tests bypass the real focus model
note: Acknowledged. The NextPanelIndex Theory covers the pure logic. Real focus behavior across MudTabs children is the right job for Playwright; adding a browser-level test of the seven-tab arrow-key flow is a reasonable follow-up but outside the session's scope.

title: ExistingRoleNames not passed in OpenEditDialogAsync
note: Now passed in both the Add and Edit paths for defense-in-depth consistency.

title: Potential stale element reference in RoleFormDialog test
note: The button element is captured and clicked inside the same InvokeAsync; in practice MudDialog does not detach the DialogActions node on render. If flakiness surfaces, re-query after the async operation.

title: role=presentation on focusable wrapper violates ARIA
note: Dropped both tabindex=-1 and role=presentation. The wrapper is a non-interactive DOM pass-through; MudTabs owns the real roles.

title: Nullable annotation inconsistency in IsDuplicateRoleName
note: Parameter is now IEnumerable<string>? to match the runtime null guard.
